note: Phrases in live policies and code that the text of a tuned task also holds. `coder-one contamination check` fails on a distinctive match that no entry here covers, and lists every covered one with its task, which can't count as evidence for the phrase's policy or pattern. An entry names the normalized phrase, the task, the files that hold it, and its relation: `source` when the phrase was taken from the task's text (name the commits), `coincident` when it came from elsewhere and the task's text holds it anyway. A one-word entry is never distinctive, so the check reports it only when an entry here declares it; the check then confirms that the task's text holds it. No prompt reads this file. docs/coder/design/pattern-components.md explains why.
